61f70437d0.why: The second input load is already folded into PSADBW, and the SAD result, accumulated sum, and flagged index update must all be preserved.

cb5d297b7e.why: The memory operand already folds one input load into VPSADBW, while the SAD result, accumulation, and flagged index update remain necessary.

2fb12f8ca9.why: The allowed AVX-512 instructions do not fuse word absolute differences with accumulation, and the cross-half dword sum must precede zero extension.

1a4923daca.why: AVX2 requires a GPR-to-XMM transfer before the byte broadcast, and all four scalar updates produce required final values.
